active_evidence: Official HTTPS homepage loaded on 2026-07-18 in desktop/mobile captures; publishes event formats, infrastructure, gallery, phone and WhatsApp. The live title visibly says 'Só mais um site WordPress'.
problems: Live title exposes an unfinished WordPress default, directly harming trust.
Mixed HTTP image/logo URLs create avoidable security and loading friction on an HTTPS page.
The homepage describes many facilities in a long paragraph instead of scannable event-planning decisions.
Wedding, 15th birthday, and graduation imagery is present but not organized into a persuasive event journey.
Primary contact path is visually weak relative to the high-intent booking decision.
rebuild_angle: Replace the default-template impression with a polished event story: choose your occasion, see the room and infrastructure, then request a tour or quote with verified contact details.
roi_mechanism: Recover trust at the first click and shorten the path from event-type inspiration to WhatsApp/phone inquiry for weddings, 15th birthdays, and graduations.

observed_issue_urls_date.note: Default WordPress title, dense copy, mixed-protocol assets, and weak conversion hierarchy observed in captures.

colors: #1E2A3A — sampled from the official dark logo/visual assets; use as trust base.

brand_source.typography: Use a high-legibility sans for planning information paired with a restrained display serif for occasion names; this differentiates celebration without relying on generic luxury styling.

locations: Curitiba — address not clearly surfaced in the extracted homepage evidence; do not invent it.
equity_to_preserve: friendly 'guest at your own party' promise

concept_thesis: This concept can only belong to Salão de Eventos Curitiba because it makes the promise of being a guest at your own party visible through an occasion-first planning flow.
concept_rules: Start with three verified occasions as a chooser, not a generic hero.
Use one editorial timeline from idea to event day to make support tangible without inventing process steps.
Pair occasion-led serif labels with a practical sans for capacity and infrastructure facts.
Use official event photography in full-bleed crops, never stock celebration imagery.
Shift the dark logo palette into warm cream and one gold accent only at moments of celebration.
Make phone and WhatsApp inquiry persistent, with no invented address or availability claims.
factual_claim_sources: Official homepage and listed image URLs; facility and contact claims are bounded to the public page text.
